queries_run: Silicon Motion SIMO largest customer second-source OR in-house controller 2026
Silicon Motion NAND makers in-house controller outsourcing Phison Micron Kioxia 2026

findings.claim: 20-F 披露：所有主要 NAND 原廠都有內部自製（captive）控制器；若原廠擴大自製，merchant 市場可能縮小，過去 SIMO 營運結果曾因客戶自製而受負面影響。
findings.excerpt: All the major NAND flash makers also have internal captive sources of controllers. The merchant market for controllers could shrink if the NAND flash makers were to expand their usage of captive sources of controllers. In the past, our operating results were negatively affected when NAND flash customers chose to insource controllers.

findings.claim: 20-F 披露客戶集中：前五大客戶占 2025 年營收約 66%，>10% 客戶合計 58%（PHISEMI、Kioxia、AFASTOR、Micron）；未點名單一最大客戶正在導入第二供應商。
findings.excerpt: Sales to our five largest customers represented approximately 61%, 66% and 66% of our net revenue in 2023, 2024 and 2025, respectively. Our customers constituting more than 10% of our net revenue were (i) Micron, SK Hynix and AFASTOR in 2023, (ii) Micron, Kioxia, PHISEMI and AFASTOR in 2024 and (iii) PHISEMI, Kioxia, AFASTOR, and Micron in 2025.

customer_second_source.note: 搜尋未找到 2026 年明確報導最大客戶導入第二供應商或新增自製的來源；搜尋摘要中的管理層外包趨勢說法來自二手摘要，未取得可逐字原文，故未列入。
